metadata.rules_text:
- Model consistently underestimates true price spikes, especially in early 30-day horizon; adjust forecast upward by 2–5% for sudden upward moves.
- Overshoots after sharp spikes (e.g., 38.48 → 43.97) — cap forecast peak at 10–15% below true peak for next 5–7 days.
- Mean reversion bias: model overcorrects downward after spikes; add 1–3% upward bias in 10–14 day horizon if sentiment neutral or slightly positive.
- Sentiment history flat (all 0.00) implies no market sentiment signal — treat as “no news” and apply conservative correction: add 1–3% to forecast if true outcome > 1.5σ above recent mean.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecast often lags true trend by 2–5 days; shift forecast 1–2 days ahead if true outcome shows accelerating trend.
- If true outcome exceeds 10% above 30-day moving average, reduce forecast by 1–3% for next 7 days to avoid overconfidence in momentum.
